scope: Existinghardware physical placement only. No new numerical format, sparsity, router, decoder, native operator or simultaneous chip context. Compiler/firmware/runtime metadata and scheduling of existing commands are potential software contributions, subject to a concrete implementation.
central_judgment: Generic mathematical expressibility is not an impossibility theorem for systems contribution. Conversely, a new name or an unadapted baseline does not establish novelty. The question is whether a concrete legal backend compiler/runtime solves a previously unvalidated constraint interaction and survives equally capable adapted controls. No fixed performance percentage or new-mathematics requirement is imposed.

sources.title: DIAMoND: Dynamic Inference for Adaptive Edge MOE with Heterogeneous In-NAND and Near-DRAM Compute Architecture, ISCA2026
sources.read_depth: Official abstract/metadata only, inherited verified project source entry; full mapping not reviewed.

sources.fair_same_backend_adaptation: Compare backend capabilities and exact native mapping once full text is available; do not declare all prior excluded.

actual_native_obligations.obligation: Complete output rows must fit legal page/4planeWL/block streams; page/wave rounding is discrete and changes the number and duration of native calls.
actual_native_obligations.phenomenon: G4GU24waves cannot achieve maximum native-job depth2: arbitrary active-chip capacity1020rows<1024;25waves suffice. All16active24wave capacity1016. This creates a real work/depth frontier, not just equal-byte bucket load.
actual_native_obligations.needed_software: A profile enumerator and address-layout compiler that retains row identity, counts padding/block boundaries and emits existing GEMV extents. A certificate is useful evidence, not a prerequisite for systems publication.

actual_native_obligations.obligation: One chip job owns its input state and output path until channel drain; native matrix-block calls are nonpreemptive. Do not execute two private-input contexts on onechip.
actual_native_obligations.phenomenon: Less total work can have a worse attainable critical path; controller/channel/host contention can reverse rankings. A max-chip work lower bound need not be schedulable.
actual_native_obligations.needed_software: Asynchronous controller-side queues/completion tracking with explicit per-chip ownership and input reload. This is existing-command orchestration, not newPE hardware.

actual_native_obligations.obligation: All GU shard outputs for one expert must reach host, then the existing activation/input preparation executes, before any down job for that expert. Shared expert is an always-active peer task with its own GU/down dependency.
actual_native_obligations.phenomenon: Opposite placement increases own-expert depth3+1to3+2 yet attenuates routing-load slope; wave profiles shorten depth3to2 at added work. Copy benefit can reverse after adding shared tasks.
actual_native_obligations.needed_software: A graph compiler with row-output reassembly and exact completion counters, shared+routed tasks in one scheduler, and an optimizer that assesses full-block latency rather than serial phase sums.

actual_native_obligations.obligation: Every potential copy is stored at fixed legal addresses and charged in pages/reserved space. Reading both adjacent rowtiles can be one longer existing command; onecopy still computes each logical row once.
actual_native_obligations.phenomenon: Replica-owner choice changes job size/count and sharedGU readiness, not merely device token counts.
actual_native_obligations.needed_software: A tensor-view manifest, fixedcopy allocation, legal contiguous coalescing, a causal current-route selector, and output gather. No runtime weight migration or extra execution contexts are needed.

actual_native_obligations.obligation: Paper aif_post/aif_gemv are matrix requests, and aif_post advertises equal-chip partitioning. A concrete firmware mapping layer must realize subsets/unequal rows/copies while keeping native chip commands unchanged.
actual_native_obligations.phenomenon: A metadata emulator cannot by itself prove an arbitrary plan can be installed or that six expertGU calls cost one host submission.
actual_native_obligations.needed_software: Either use existing per-matrix requests and charge actual host calls, or implement and measure software batching/controller metadata with unchanged chip ISA. Produce actual command traces and numeric output checks; do not silently assume a free new command or output ABI.

constructive_case.conclusion: The measured nA-only paired-copy policy is exactly two complete sharedGU copies, one g8striped on each half, plus A/B/hybrid views. All7nA states, both priorities and18actual replica traces match. This is a constructive same-backend equality, stronger than claiming generic RDA can express it.
constructive_case.consequence: The current paired-row copy placement/selector cannot be presented as a distinct new replica algorithm. Its cost benefit may still support an implemented native backend/compiler finding. Independent per-pair or DAG-aware choices remain separate hypotheses and must beat this equal-view control.

candidate_claims.text: A semantics-preserving compiler/runtime for existing dense in-flash GEMV jointly chooses legal whole-row profiles and fixed replica views for shared+routed MoE, and executes their readinessDAG on finite chip/channel/host resources. It resolves a reproducible phase-only/expected-load ranking failure while preserving native operators and full outputs.
candidate_claims.what_would_be_new: The concrete lowering, legal physical plan/metadata, finite-context asynchronous execution and validated cost-aware planning on this backend, if no prior implementation already supplies them. Existing optimization primitives may be reused.
currently_missing: Executable model image/PPAs and native command lowering for the plans
Measured selector/launch/gather/activation costs and consistent numericformat
End-to-end FFNblock including shared tasks, plus robust multi-model/shape evidence

candidate_claims.text: On existing in-flash commands, spatial work and per-expert readiness depth form a quantized frontier. More total read work or an extra fixedGU copy can lower block tail, while a phase-only winner can lose after shared contention. A reusable planner/runtime exposes and exploits this frontier.
candidate_claims.qualification: A new theorem is not required. The phenomenon must be reproducible under one backend and survive same-feature baselines; one tiny trainingcase or a cost-model change is insufficient. A small effect can be informative if measured rigorously and explained; a large effect from denied baseline features is not.

candidate_claims.text: The supplied4.6%shared-copy result is evidence of a useful storage/performance tradeoff under the current simulator, not evidence that a new replication strategy has been invented.
candidate_claims.qualification: DeepSeek/EPLB/Megatron are direct conceptual prior; the exact three-view control is equivalent. An integration claim must contribute the native realization, broader characterization or a selector beyond that control and show why a generic adapted implementation does not already achieve it.

strong_controls.adaptation: Exactly the tested layout and all three views; same120MiBfull40extra, same coalescing, hostinput and selected rows. This control must reproduce the current paired-copy results pointwise.

Treat legal rowjobs/projection stages as objects; sharedfrequency1 and actual sensing/compute cost; equal byte budget. Allow arbitrary count packing when physical capacity permits. Apply same copies, coalescing and DAG runtime. Include an oracle selector and a measured bounded-overhead implementation.

Use a catalog of feasible complete-row profiles, actual pages/waves and shared work; preserve coactivation/statistical objective as one control and strengthen to fullDAG as another. All plans run on the same scheduler; do not use infeasible continuous fractions or extra contexts.
Minimize input/output and job costs over the same permitted whole-row shapes; no imported hardware broadcast/slicing. Give the same legal adjacent native-matrix coalescing.

strong_controls.control: PowerInfer-style expert-ready pipeline / Megatron-style shared overlap
strong_controls.adaptation: Make these runtime features common to all placements. Wholeexpert cluster granularity respects unchanged activation/input preparation. Shared runs concurrently and contends for actual resources.

Use the same fixed native-rowtiles, physical copybudget, legal coalescing and causal selector. Separate DAG-oblivious load balance from a DAG-aware cost extension. If the latter ties the candidate, do not claim a new placement algorithm; assess any compiler/runtime contribution on its actual implementation.

Compare identical byte budgets, not identical replica counts. WholeGU duplication already matches120MiB. Whole sharedFFN duplication includes down and costs more, so compare on a storage/mean/tail frontier rather than using it as the sole weaker control.

falsification_experiments.test: Replay two fullGU copies with A/B/hybrid views against current paired selector, identical graph and costs.
falsification_experiments.failure: Exact equality is already verified; discard novelpaired-copy algorithm wording.

falsification_experiments.test: Cross copylayouts(random/paired/frequency/coactivation) with selectors(fixed,current-loadflow,DAGaware), same bytes and runtime. Include no-copy and fullGU-copy controls.
falsification_experiments.failure: If only adding the known hotshared copy matters, this is a replication application. If selector gains vanish with equal views, no new placement policy is established.

falsification_experiments.test: Fit phase-only and joint objectives with matched budget, and also optimize phase-only plans against actual isolated resource schedules rather than only NANDbounds. Replay barrier/ready and shared overlap under identical resources.
falsification_experiments.failure: If the difference comes from changing the baseline cost model, withholding overlap, or solver quality, do not attribute it to a native placement insight.

falsification_experiments.test: Enumerate feasible rowprofiles from real model geometries; evaluate bytes/pages/waves/jobs/depth with calibrated costs. Include profiles with higher work and lower depth and the strongest simpleopposite/wave controls.
falsification_experiments.failure: If extra work/depth is not charged, if only one cherry-picked geometry wins, or if a samebackend legal profilebaseline already dominates, narrow or drop the performanceclaim.

falsification_experiments.test: Permit identical adjacent-row coalescing for all controls; audit every jobinput/output ownership interval and blockboundary. Add free-context/preemption only as explicitly unrealizable diagnostic upperbounds.
falsification_experiments.failure: Any gain requiring extra contexts,newkernel semantics,or denied baseline coalescing fails the existinghardware claim.

falsification_experiments.test: Use realroutes and labeled synthetic sensitivities with same expert marginals/different coactivation or same homecount histogram. Compare nativeflow and nA-only selectors.
falsification_experiments.failure: If performance depends only on nA histogram, do not call the sharedselector coactivation-learning. Synthetic pathological loads cannot substitute for real workload benefit.

falsification_experiments.test: Materialize static images/views and run an executable host/controller path; count actual aif_gemv submissions, interrupts,inputuploads,selector,gather,activation/combine. Validate functional full-row equivalence.
falsification_experiments.failure: If gains vanish after real overhead, or require unimplemented request semantics,newrawoutputdtype or differentquantization, the speedclaim fails even if the simulator is internally consistent.

falsification_experiments.test: Evaluate shared+routed in one resourceDAG across fullmodel layers; freeze family choices before newrouting. Report mean/P95/P99 and prompt-block uncertainty; never sum layerpercentiles or serially add shared cost.
falsification_experiments.failure: If the benefit disappears with sharedcontention, distribution shift or a stronger simpletail baseline, revise the claim to the observed subcase. Current first3layerP99 does not establish fullmodel P99.

falsification_experiments.test: Sweep or measure command/host/PE/transfer/read costs with the same profiles and all baselines. Separate physicalpages,allocatedwaves and reservedcapacity.
falsification_experiments.failure: If an advantage is only a speculative timingconstant or an arbitrary equal-count capacityquota, it is not evidence of a robust systems speedup.

Relative strongest previous mean1.319144006ms:0.303%; relative strongest previoustail1.412364ms:3.257%. Matchedwithinnewfamily mean benefit1.143%. present_evidence.shared: Root/source shared-pipeline fulltrain first3layer screen reports bestonecopymean1.722549086ms vs bestcopymean1.643668789ms and bestonecopyP991.807190ms vs bestcopyP991.72432518ms. Fixed gatefirst and only a few mappings; generic samebudget controls remain missing.
present_evidence.evidence_boundary: These are service simulations and traces, not measured AiFhardware. No percentage is treated as a novelty threshold. The originalQQUF/rawI8 format and hostABI scope must remain explicit.

unresolved: Whether a public AiFimplementation can install the proposed physicalplans without unsupported commands
Generic native-tile replica selection and samebudget completeview controls on full shared/routed runtime
conclusion: Potentially publishable nativebackend systems work remains possible; the present result establishes neither publicationnovelty nor impossibility. Current paired-copy algorithm is constructively old-style tensorreplica/view selection. The strongest path is a concrete reusable legality/cost-aware compiler+runtime and a falsifiable resourceDAG finding, with baseline adaptations and numeric/physical evidence completed.
